templates.title: Complete Wedding Planning Checklist
templates.description: Comprehensive wedding planning checklist organized by timeline from 12 months before to wedding day. Covers all major wedding planning tasks and details.
templates.seoTitle: Complete Wedding Planning Checklist - 12 Month Timeline
templates.seoDescription: Ultimate wedding planning checklist with timeline from 12 months to wedding day. Never miss a detail with our comprehensive guide for your perfect wedding.

items.title: Set overall wedding budget
items.description: Determine total budget and allocate to different categories

contents.value:
## Budget Allocation Guidelines

- **Venue & Catering**: 40-50% of budget
- **Photography/Videography**: 10-15%
- **Attire**: 8-10%
- **Flowers**: 8-10%
- **Music/Entertainment**: 8-10%
- **Transportation**: 3-5%
- **Miscellaneous**: 5-10%

contents.value:
**Photography Tips**:
- Review full wedding galleries, not just highlight reels
- Meet photographers in person or video call
- Understand what's included in packages
- Ask about engagement session inclusion
- Clarify timeline and delivery expectations
